title: The False All-Hands
background: At a lakeside lodge hosting an all-hands retreat for navigation startup BrightCurrent, CEO Lena Orrow is found dead in the prototype lab shortly after the evening presentations. She was discovered at 9:35 p.m. beside a shattered demonstration drone, killed by a blow to the head.
key_evidence: The conference tablet's immutable audit log shows Rowan Vale's supposed 9:20 live all-hands appearance was launched from a prerecorded file at 9:19, while the fixed dining-room camera shows only the unattended tablet.

Rowan Vale.relationship_to_victim: Lena's cofounder and longtime business partner
Rowan Vale.motive: Lena had discovered Rowan falsified test results and planned to remove him from the company.

Mara Quill.motive: Lena intended to cancel Mara's lucrative retention package after the retreat.

Tomas Reed.relationship_to_victim: A former protégé whose drone design Lena claimed as her own
Tomas Reed.motive: Tomas believed Lena had stolen his work and was preparing to fire him.

Sable Chen.relationship_to_victim: Lena's principal board liaison and former college friend
Sable Chen.motive: Lena threatened to expose Sable's unauthorized side deal with a rival startup.

timeline.Rowan Vale: At 9:21 p.m. in the prototype lab, Rowan struck Lena with a brass drone weight and then returned to the dining hall tablet before anyone noticed the prerecorded all-hands feed.
timeline.Mara Quill: At 9:21 p.m. in the lodge kitchen, Mara was inventorying the retreat's catering supplies with the night chef.
timeline.Tomas Reed: At 9:21 p.m. on the lakeshore dock, Tomas was repairing a damaged charging cable under the dock lights.
timeline.Sable Chen: At 9:21 p.m. in the upstairs lounge, Sable was on a documented video call with the investment committee.

statements.Rowan Vale: I delivered the all-hands presentation live from the dining-room tablet at 9:20 p.m. Lena's concerns had put our partnership under severe strain, but I intended to resolve the dispute through the company's formal process.
statements.Mara Quill: At 9:21 p.m., I was in the lodge kitchen inventorying catering supplies alongside the night chef. Lena's plan to cancel my retention package had angered me, but I was focused on keeping the retreat running that evening.
statements.Tomas Reed: At 9:21 p.m., I was on the lakeshore dock repairing a damaged charging cable beneath the dock lights. During dinner I accused Lena publicly of stealing my drone design, and I have secretly kept a folder of hostile messages about her.
statements.Sable Chen: At 9:21 p.m., I was in the upstairs lounge on a documented video call with the investment committee. Lena's threat to expose my unauthorized side deal with a rival startup gave me a serious reason to resent her, but I stayed engaged with the committee.

title: The Looping Storm
background: During a violent storm, four guests shelter at remote Blackthorn Manor, where reclusive owner Alistair Venn is found dead in his locked map room. He has been struck with a brass surveyor's weight, and the windows are sealed against the rain.
key_evidence: The conservatory security camera's file shows Ivo Mercer there at 10:15, but the estate server audit independently proves that this section was overwritten at 10:32 with a repeating six-minute loop; the apparent camera alibi is therefore false.

Ivo Mercer.relationship_to_victim: Alistair hired Ivo to modernize the manor's failing security system.
Ivo Mercer.motive: Alistair discovered Ivo had been secretly selling the manor's architectural plans to developers.

Beatrice Venn.relationship_to_victim: She was disinherited by Alistair after a bitter dispute over their mother's estate.
Beatrice Venn.motive: She stood to inherit nothing unless Alistair changed his will.

Jonah Pell.relationship_to_victim: Jonah supplied Alistair with rare maps and had recently been accused of selling him fakes.
Jonah Pell.motive: Alistair threatened to expose Jonah's forgery scheme to the police.

Mara Quill.relationship_to_victim: Mara had kept Blackthorn Manor running for twelve years and knew its hidden passages.
Mara Quill.motive: Alistair planned to sell the manor, leaving Mara without a home or job.

timeline.Ivo Mercer: At 10:15, Ivo was actually inside the map room, striking Alistair with the brass surveyor's weight before returning to the conservatory and activating the prerecorded camera loop.
timeline.Beatrice Venn: At 10:15, Beatrice was in the upstairs guest bedroom, telephoning her solicitor through the manor's landline.
timeline.Jonah Pell: At 10:15, Jonah was in the wine cellar cataloguing bottles while the storm kept the cellar door visibly propped open.
timeline.Mara Quill: At 10:15, Mara was in the kitchen restarting the range after the power flickered, where the cook's external delivery driver saw her through the window.

statements.Ivo Mercer: At 10:15, I was in the conservatory, where the storm made the failing security system especially urgent. As Alistair's technology consultant, I had been working to modernize the manor's defenses and was prepared to explain the system's problems.
statements.Beatrice Venn: At 10:15, I was upstairs in the guest bedroom, speaking with my solicitor over the manor's landline. I had argued loudly with Alistair about my disinheritance before dinner, and the bitterness between us was no secret.
statements.Jonah Pell: At 10:15, I was in the wine cellar cataloguing bottles while the storm kept the cellar door visibly propped open. Alistair had accused me of selling forged maps and threatened to report me, so our former friendship had become openly hostile.
statements.Mara Quill: At 10:15, I was in the kitchen restarting the range after the power flickered, and the external delivery driver could see me through the window. Alistair's plan to sell the manor threatened my home and employment, leaving me with plenty to resent.

title: The Silent Stand-Up
background: At a lakeside lodge, startup founder Mara Venn gathers her four senior colleagues for a retreat meant to settle a bitter dispute over the company's future. During a storm-blackened evening, Mara is found dead in the locked boathouse, struck with a brass emergency oar bracket. The company's all-hands presentation was supposedly taking place at the lodge at the time of the killing.
key_evidence: The lodge's independently archived all-hands livestream contains an exactly repeated 11-second segment of audio and video from 9:41:12 to 9:41:23, proving that the apparent live presentation was a loop rather than a continuous broadcast. The boathouse's motion camera records a figure in the killer's distinctive silver retreat jacket entering at 9:40 and leaving at 9:45.

Ilan Rusk.relationship_to_victim: Mara's longtime business partner and the executive who was supposed to deliver the all-hands presentation
Ilan Rusk.motive: Mara had discovered Ilan secretly diverting investor money into a private shell company and planned to remove him the next morning

Priya Sato.relationship_to_victim: Mara's former research collaborator and current rival over control of the company's core technology
Priya Sato.motive: Mara intended to cancel Priya's flagship project after a disastrous security audit

Gideon Vale.relationship_to_victim: Mara's public-facing lieutenant, whose fundraising success depended on her reputation
Gideon Vale.motive: Mara had learned Gideon fabricated several investor reports and was preparing to expose him

Nessa Quill.relationship_to_victim: Mara's former roommate, who still resented Mara for taking credit for a hospitality app they designed together
Nessa Quill.motive: Mara had refused to pay Nessa the promised share of the app's sale and had threatened to discredit her publicly

timeline.Ilan Rusk: At 9:40 p.m., Ilan was actually in the boathouse wearing his silver retreat jacket, killed Mara with the brass oar bracket, and returned to the lodge at 9:45 after starting a prerecorded loop of his all-hands presentation.
timeline.Priya Sato: At 9:42 p.m., Priya was in the main lodge kitchen repairing a damaged tablet while the catering assistant watched her from the doorway.
timeline.Gideon Vale: At 9:42 p.m., Gideon was on the covered lakeside porch calling an investor in Chicago, whose phone records confirm the uninterrupted call.
timeline.Nessa Quill: At 9:42 p.m., Nessa was in the reception office printing updated room assignments, where the lodge printer's timestamped job log places her.

statements.Ilan Rusk: Mara and I had serious disagreements about the company's finances, but I intended to address them through the proper channels. At 9:42 p.m., I was in the lodge delivering the all-hands presentation live.
statements.Priya Sato: Mara and I were openly at odds over the future of my security-troubled project, and I knew she might cancel it. At 9:42 p.m., I was in the main lodge kitchen repairing a damaged tablet while the catering assistant watched from the doorway.
statements.Gideon Vale: Mara's plans to expose my reporting errors threatened my work and the reputation I had built around her company. At 9:42 p.m., I was on the covered lakeside porch speaking with an investor in Chicago on an uninterrupted call.
statements.Nessa Quill: Mara and I had a furious argument over the app idea before dinner, and I still secretly kept her old access card despite her demands that I return it. At 9:42 p.m., I was in the reception office printing updated room assignments from the lodge printer.

title: The Stormglass Murder
background: During a violent weekend storm, four uneasy guests are stranded at Blackthorn Manor, whose owner, Octavia Rusk, has threatened to expose one of them. Octavia is found dead in her locked map room at 10:20 p.m., stabbed with an antique letter opener. The storm has cut the manor off from the nearest village, leaving only the four suspects inside.
key_evidence: The manor's battery-backed security camera records Celia Wren clearly standing in the glasshouse at 10:20 p.m., the established time of the killing; the glasshouse has no connection to the map room and its only door was visibly blocked by fallen timber. The recording's timestamp was independently synchronized with the emergency radio clock.

Mara Vale.relationship_to_victim: Octavia's longtime manager, who had recently been accused of diverting repair funds.
Mara Vale.motive: Octavia planned to dismiss Mara and report the missing money.

Jonah Rusk.relationship_to_victim: Octavia's nephew and intended heir, recently removed from her will after a bitter argument.
Jonah Rusk.motive: He stood to lose the manor and its fortune.

Celia Wren.relationship_to_victim: A specialist hired by Octavia to authenticate a valuable collection of maps.
Celia Wren.motive: Octavia had discovered that Celia had secretly substituted several valuable originals with replicas.

Bram Alder.relationship_to_victim: A former employee who still supplied Octavia with provisions during the isolation.
Bram Alder.motive: Octavia had accused Bram of poaching and threatened to have him arrested.

timeline.Mara Vale: At 10:20 p.m., Mara was in the boiler room resetting the storm-damaged heating controls.
timeline.Jonah Rusk: At 10:20 p.m., Jonah was in the west corridor trying to force open the jammed front door with a fire poker.
timeline.Celia Wren: At 10:20 p.m., Celia was actually in the map room, where she stabbed Octavia and then slipped out through the concealed archive passage.
timeline.Bram Alder: At 10:20 p.m., Bram was in the entrance hall speaking by radio with the stranded county patrol officer.

statements.Mara Vale: At 10:20 p.m., I was in the boiler room resetting the storm-damaged heating controls. Octavia's accusations about repair funds had put my position at risk, but I was focused on keeping the manor's heating running through the storm.
statements.Jonah Rusk: At 10:20 p.m., I was in the west corridor trying to force open the jammed front door with a fire poker. I had argued bitterly with Octavia about removing me from her will, and I understand why that desperation makes me look guilty.
statements.Celia Wren: At 10:20 p.m., I was in the map room examining Octavia's collection when the storm intensified outside. Her discovery about the substituted maps threatened my reputation, but I had intended to finish the authentication work and leave the matter to be discussed.
statements.Bram Alder: At 10:20 p.m., I was in the entrance hall speaking by radio with the stranded county patrol officer. Octavia's threat to have me arrested over alleged poaching had angered me, but I was occupied with the storm and the patrol's instructions.

title: The Last Build
background: At a lakeside lodge, startup founder Elias Venn is found dead in the boathouse during his company's tense all-hands retreat. He lies beside a shattered prototype drone, apparently killed by a blow to the head shortly after announcing that one employee would be dismissed. The retreat's isolated grounds contain only four people with plausible motives.
key_evidence: At 9:18 p.m., the server shed's isolated badge reader recorded Priya Nair's physical access card, which requires contact with the card and cannot be triggered remotely. The shed was empty when checked at 9:27, while the boathouse camera shows no one entering or leaving through its only visible door between 9:10 and 9:25.

Priya Nair.relationship_to_victim: Elias's co-founder, whose security platform he planned to sell without her approval
Priya Nair.motive: She feared losing control of the technology and being forced out after the sale.

Marcus Bell.relationship_to_victim: Elias's longtime friend and the executive responsible for the company's disappointing revenue
Marcus Bell.motive: Elias had threatened to expose Marcus's falsified client projections.

Tessa Wu.relationship_to_victim: The inventor whose drone prototype Elias publicly claimed as his own
Tessa Wu.motive: She had recently confronted Elias and threatened to resign with the design files.

Jonah Reed.relationship_to_victim: Elias's former partner, now responsible for the lodge retreat and company logistics
Jonah Reed.motive: Elias had ended their relationship and planned to replace Jonah with an outside operations firm.

timeline.Priya Nair: At 9:18 p.m., Priya was actually in the boathouse striking Elias with the drone's metal battery casing, while her access card had been planted on the server shed's reader.
timeline.Marcus Bell: At 9:18 p.m., Marcus was in the lodge dining room on a video call with a prospective client, witnessed by the client and two staff members.
timeline.Tessa Wu: At 9:18 p.m., Tessa was in the workshop repairing a flight controller, where the lodge's maintenance camera recorded her continuously.
timeline.Jonah Reed: At 9:18 p.m., Jonah was at the front desk printing revised retreat schedules, and the lodge printer log records his job at that time.

statements.Priya Nair: Elias's plan to sell our security platform threatened my control of the work we built together, and I had every reason to oppose him. At 9:18 p.m., I entered the boathouse through its only visible door and spoke with Elias there.
statements.Marcus Bell: Elias's threat to expose my client projections put my position and reputation at risk, but I was not alone during the critical moment. At 9:18 p.m., I was in the lodge dining room on a video call with a prospective client, witnessed by the client and two staff members.
statements.Tessa Wu: I had a furious public argument with Elias that afternoon after he claimed my drone design as his own, and I was angry enough for everyone to notice. At 9:18 p.m., I was in the workshop repairing a flight controller, where the lodge maintenance camera recorded me continuously.
statements.Jonah Reed: Elias's decision to replace me with an outside operations firm made our failed relationship and my place in the company painfully uncertain. At 9:18 p.m., I was at the front desk printing revised retreat schedules, and the lodge printer log records my job at that time.

The retreat's four senior employees are the only people with reason to approach her privately that night.

Priya Quill.motive: Mara planned to cancel Priya's lucrative consulting arrangement and replace her with an outside agency

title: The Stormglass Murder
background: During a violent weekend storm at remote Blackthorn Manor, antique-glass collector Alistair Wren gathers three associates to announce a change to his will. At 10:25 p.m., he is found dead in the locked map room, slumped beside a shattered stormglass and a cup of untouched brandy.
key_evidence: The battery-backed security camera in the conservatory records Mara Venn's face continuously from 10:17 to 10:24 p.m., while the map room's sealed window and single monitored doorway show that nobody entered or left it during that interval. The manor physician establishes that Alistair died from a fast-acting poison at approximately 10:20 p.m.

Mara Venn.relationship_to_victim: She had managed Blackthorn Manor for twelve years and knew every room and security system.
Mara Venn.motive: Alistair discovered she had been diverting restoration funds and planned to dismiss her and report her.

Jonas Wren.relationship_to_victim: He was Alistair's only living heir, though their relationship had become openly hostile.
Jonas Wren.motive: Alistair had recently rewritten his will to leave the estate to a preservation charity.

Dr. Celia Orra.relationship_to_victim: She had advised Alistair on preserving his collection and supplied medicines for his chronic pain.
Dr. Celia Orra.motive: Alistair possessed letters proving that Celia had falsified research data decades earlier.

Piers Bell.relationship_to_victim: He was cataloguing the manor's collection under a disputed contract with Alistair.
Piers Bell.motive: Alistair intended to cancel the contract and expose Piers's plagiarism in an upcoming book.

timeline.Mara Venn: At 10:20 p.m., Mara was actually inside the map room, having used a maintenance key to enter and administer poison to Alistair before leaving through the concealed dumbwaiter shaft.
timeline.Jonas Wren: At 10:20 p.m., Jonas was in the west guest corridor arguing with the storm-damaged telephone line and did not enter the map room.
timeline.Dr. Celia Orra: At 10:20 p.m., Celia was in the library writing notes beside the fireplace, where the housekeeper saw her.
timeline.Piers Bell: At 10:20 p.m., Piers was in the dining room photographing water damage to the ceiling, using a flash that was visible from the main hall.

statements.Jonas Wren: Alistair and I had a loud argument earlier, after he told me I would receive nothing from his new will. At 10:20 p.m., I was in the west guest corridor wrestling with the storm-damaged telephone line and never entered the map room.
statements.Dr. Celia Orra: Alistair’s threats about my old research were deeply troubling, but I kept my attention on my notes and his medical records. At 10:20 p.m., I was in the library writing beside the fireplace, where the housekeeper could see me.

title: The Bitter Morning
background: The day after the grand reopening of Honeycomb & Rye, owner Silas Venn is found dead in the flour storeroom before sunrise, his skull crushed by a brass dough weight. The bakery is still locked, and the four people with reasons to resent Silas are the only ones known to have been nearby.
key_evidence: A municipal traffic camera records Liora Quill's distinctive blue van crossing the river bridge toward the bakery at 5:41 a.m., and the bakery's electronic loading-door log records her keycard opening that door at 5:42; this directly disproves her claim that she was at home across the river during the murder window.

Liora Quill.role: Head baker and Silas's business partner
Liora Quill.relationship_to_victim: Silas had promised her a larger share of the bakery, then threatened to dismiss her after the reopening.
Liora Quill.motive: She feared losing both her livelihood and the recipes she had spent years developing.

Marek Doss.relationship_to_victim: Silas owed him six months of unpaid invoices and had recently switched suppliers.
Marek Doss.motive: He needed the debt settled before his own small business collapsed.

Tessa Venn.role: Silas's estranged younger sister and bookkeeper
Tessa Venn.relationship_to_victim: Silas controlled their late mother's bakery shares and refused to release Tessa's inheritance.
Tessa Venn.motive: She stood to inherit the building if Silas died without changing his will.

Bram Alder.relationship_to_victim: Silas had publicly accused Bram of stealing cash from the reopening-night register.
Bram Alder.motive: He was about to be fired and reported to the police.

timeline.Liora Quill: At 5:44 a.m., Liora was in the flour storeroom striking Silas with the brass dough weight, despite later claiming she had remained at home across the river.
timeline.Marek Doss: At 5:44 a.m., Marek was parked at the east market loading crates of rye flour, where the market's receiving clerk saw him.
timeline.Tessa Venn: At 5:44 a.m., Tessa was in the bakery office photographing Silas's altered will, then left through the front entrance at 5:51.
timeline.Bram Alder: At 5:44 a.m., Bram was scrubbing the outside pavement beneath the front windows, visible to the newspaper carrier who passed at that time.

statements.Liora Quill: At 5:42 a.m., I was still at home across the river, nowhere near Honeycomb & Rye. Silas's threats to dismiss me and take the recipes I developed gave me every reason to resent him, but I had not returned to the bakery that morning.
statements.Marek Doss: At 5:44 a.m., I was at the east market unloading rye flour, with the receiving clerk watching the crates come in. I had a furious public argument with Silas during the reopening and threatened to make him regret withholding six months of invoices, but I was still working at the market when he died.
statements.Tessa Venn: At 5:44 a.m., I was in the bakery office photographing Silas's altered will, and I left through the front entrance at 5:51. I wanted the inheritance he kept from me, and I was angry enough to confront him, but I did not enter the flour storeroom.
statements.Bram Alder: At 5:44 a.m., I was scrubbing the pavement beneath the bakery's front windows, plainly visible to the newspaper carrier. Silas had accused me of stealing from the reopening register and was preparing to fire me and call the police, so I had plenty to fear from him.

title: The Shattered Exhibition
background: At the opening night of the Brackenmere Gallery, a skylight was found broken and several display alarms had been triggered. Gallery director Celia Marr was discovered dead in the restoration room at 9:29 p.m., struck with a bronze framing tool while the guests were still being evacuated. The apparent break-in seemed to have been staged to conceal a personal killing.
key_evidence: The restoration room's biometric lock recorded Rowan Pike's fingerprint opening the door at 9:16 p.m., and the corridor camera shows that no one exited before the body was found at 9:29. The courtyard camera also shows Rowan was not in the courtyard during that interval, despite his claimed alibi.

Rowan Pike.relationship_to_victim: Celia had discovered that Rowan was falsifying provenance records for valuable paintings.
Rowan Pike.motive: He feared exposure, dismissal, and prosecution for the forged records.

Nessa Quill.relationship_to_victim: Celia had publicly rejected Nessa's newest work and threatened to remove her from the exhibition.
Nessa Quill.motive: Nessa believed Celia had ruined her career and cost her a major commission.

Dorian Vale.relationship_to_victim: Celia had blamed Dorian for the earlier break-in that damaged the gallery's reputation.
Dorian Vale.motive: He was about to lose his contract and had been denied payment for emergency repairs.

Mira Saye.relationship_to_victim: Celia held a disputed insurance claim over a painting Mira had lent to the gallery.
Mira Saye.motive: Mira feared Celia would reveal that she had secretly replaced the insured original with a convincing copy.

timeline.Nessa Quill: At 9:16 p.m. in the east loading bay, Nessa was helping an uninvolved caterer's assistant retrieve crates of discarded packing foam.

timeline.Mira Saye: At 9:16 p.m. in the auction salon, Mira was signing a transport receipt with the visiting appraiser.

statements.Dorian Vale: At 9:16 p.m., I was in the main lobby resetting the fire-alarm panel while three departing guests watched me work. Celia's blame over the earlier break-in and her refusal to pay for emergency repairs put my contract under serious strain.
statements.Mira Saye: At 9:16 p.m., I was in the auction salon signing a transport receipt with the visiting appraiser. Celia's disputed insurance claim over my loaned painting threatened to expose the private arrangement I had worked hard to keep concealed.

title: The Bitter Second Rise

key_evidence: A time-synchronized security camera at the neighboring pharmacy records Elian entering the flour room at 5:47 a.m. and records the back door opening from inside at 5:52 a.m.; no person enters the bakery from the street between those times. The bakery alarm log confirms that the back door was opened only once, at 5:52 a.m.

Mara Quill.relationship_to_victim: Elian's longtime business partner, recently demoted after the reopening
Mara Quill.motive: She feared Elian was planning to sell the bakery and cut her out.

Jonas Pike.relationship_to_victim: A former employee who had been dismissed by Elian six months earlier
Jonas Pike.motive: Elian had accused him of stealing ingredients and had refused to give him a reference.

Tessa Voss.relationship_to_victim: Elian's niece, who secretly discovered irregularities in the bakery accounts
Tessa Voss.motive: Elian had threatened to expose her embezzlement to the family.

Calder Reed.relationship_to_victim: A rival and former friend whose negative review could ruin the reopened bakery
Calder Reed.motive: Elian had discovered Calder was accepting money from competing restaurants for favorable reviews.

timeline.Jonas Pike: At 5:52 a.m., Jonas was standing outside the bakery beside his delivery van, waiting for the rear door to open.
timeline.Tessa Voss: At 5:52 a.m., Tessa was inside the flour room, having opened the back door from within and struck Elian with the cast-iron mixing weight before leaving through the kitchen.
timeline.Calder Reed: At 5:50 a.m., Calder was in the neighboring pharmacy's newspaper kiosk, where the pharmacist saw him waiting for the morning papers.
